"""Contract tests for the eMicro control plane (development scratch)."""
import json, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/emicro-deps')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('drv', '/workspace/project/driver.py')
drv = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(drv)

FAILS = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILS.append('%s: got %r want %r' % (name, got, want))

def run(req):
    if isinstance(req, (dict, list)):
        req = json.dumps(req).encode()
    return drv.solve(req)

LIM = {'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
def job(events, services=None, limits=None):
    if services is None: services = [{'name':'A','label':10},{'name':'B','label':4}]
    return {'services':services,'limits':limits or LIM,'events':events}

def evs(jobobj):
    r = run({'jobs':[jobobj]})
    return r['results'][0].get('events')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- envelope
check('empty jobs', run(b'{"jobs":[]}'), {'results':[]})
check('bad top', run(b'{"jobs":{},"x":1}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('dup key', run(b'{"jobs":[],"jobs":[]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('dup nested', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[]}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('nan', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":NaN}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('inf float', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":1e400}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('underflow ok', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":1e-400}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})  # job level
check('bom', run(b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"jobs":[]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('trailing json', run(b'{"jobs":[]} {}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('trailing ws', run(b'{"jobs":[]}  \n\t'), {'results':[]})
check('bad utf8', run(b'{"jobs":[\xff]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('big int', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":' + b'1'*5000 + b'}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('float field', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":1.5}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
# nesting
nested='0'
for _ in range(62): nested='['+nested+']'
check('depth 64 job', run(('{"jobs":['+nested+']}').encode()), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('depth 65 req', run(('{"jobs":[['+nested+']]}').encode()), {'error':'invalid'})
# 5 jobs
check('5 jobs', run({'jobs':[job([])]*5}), {'error':'invalid'})
# job level errors
check('empty services', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('bad limits', run({'jobs':[job([], limits={'images':1})]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('limit zero', run({'jobs':[job([], limits=dict(LIM, units=0))]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('limit over', run({'jobs':[job([], limits=dict(LIM, units=1025))]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('dup label', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':1},{'name':'B','label':1}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('dup name', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':1},{'name':'A','label':2}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('label 0', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':0}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('label max', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':4294967295}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('label 4294967294', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':4294967294}])]}), {'results':[{'results':[{'events':[{'ok':True,'active':None,'images':[],'units':0,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}]}]}]})
check('17 services', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'S%d'%i,'label':i+1} for i in range(17)])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('bad name', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'1A','label':1}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('long name', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A'*25,'label':1}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('unknown op', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'nope'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('extra field', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'inspect','x':1}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('missing field', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'commit'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('bool not int', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'commit','epoch':True}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('surrogate policy', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+json.dumps(LIM).encode()+b',"events":[{"op":"stage","epoch":1,"policy":"\\ud800"}]}]}'), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('unit ns 0 ok', evs(job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'}])), [{'ok':True}])
check('unit pid 0', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,0,1],'service':'A'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('unit gen 0', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,0],'service':'A'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('wire len 97', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'recv','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':'a'*97}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('wire len 96 ok', evs(job([{'op':'recv','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':'a'*96}])), [{'error':'rejected'}])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- policy
def stage_image(policy, services=None):
    out = evs(job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy}], services))
    return out[0]
check('empty language', stage_image(''), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False],'rows':[[4294967295,4294967295]]}})
check('all allow', stage_image('match() allow;'), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[True],'rows':[[0,0]]}})
check('drop only', stage_image('match(A) drop;'), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False],'rows':[[4294967295,4294967295]]}})
check('syntax error', stage_image('match(A) allow'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('unregistered', stage_image('match(C) allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('vertical tab', stage_image('match(A) allow;\v'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('bad action', stage_image('match(A) permit;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('depth 17', stage_image('not('*16 + 'match(A)' + ')'*16 + ' allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('depth 16', stage_image('not('*15 + 'match(A)' + ')'*15 + ' allow;')['ok'], True)
check('path 17', stage_image('match(' + ','.join(['A']*17) + ') allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('path 16', stage_image('match(' + ','.join(['A']*16) + ') allow;')['ok'], True)
check('nonmatch path 5', stage_image('startswith(A,A,A,A,A) allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('9 complex rules', stage_image(''.join('not(match(A)) drop;' for _ in range(9))), {'error':'rejected'})
check('8 complex rules', stage_image(''.join('not(match(A)) drop;' for _ in range(8)))['ok'], True)
check('33 atoms in complex', stage_image('(' + ' and '.join(['match(A)']*33) + ') allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('5 distinct nonmatch', stage_image('startswith(A) allow; endswith(B) allow; contains(A) allow; startswith(B) allow; endswith(A) allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('4 distinct nonmatch', stage_image('startswith(A) allow; endswith(B) allow; contains(A) allow; startswith(B) allow;')['ok'], True)

# image semantics: BFS numbering over increasing label order
img = stage_image('match(A) allow; match(B) allow;')['image']
# columns: B(4), A(10); language {A,B}
check('bfs labels', img, {'accept':[False,True,True],'rows':[[1,2],[1,2],[1,2]]})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- replay
E = [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A,B) allow;'},{'op':'commit','epoch':1}]
check('stage twice same epoch', evs(job(E+[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}])), [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[4294967295,1],[2,4294967295],[4294967295,4294967295]]}},{'ok':True},{'error':'rejected'}])
check('stage lower epoch', evs(job(E+[{'op':'stage','epoch':0,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}])), [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[4294967295,1],[2,4294967295],[4294967295,4294967295]]}},{'ok':True},{'error':'rejected'}])
check('commit unknown', evs(job([{'op':'commit','epoch':7}])), [{'error':'rejected'}])
check('retire active', evs(job(E+[{'op':'retire','epoch':1}])), [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[4294967295,1],[2,4294967295],[4294967295,4294967295]]}},{'ok':True},{'error':'rejected'}])
check('retire referenced', evs(job(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},{'op':'retire','epoch':1}])), [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[4294967295,1],[2,4294967295],[4294967295,4294967295]]}},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'error':'rejected'}])
# units
check('spawn twice same pair', evs(job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,2],'service':'A'}])), [{'ok':True},{'error':'rejected'}])
check('spawn gen reuse', evs(job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,1]},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'}])), [{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'error':'rejected'}])
check('spawn gen bump', evs(job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,1]},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,2],'service':'A'}])), [{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True}])

check('exit wrong gen', evs(job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,2]}])), [{'ok':True},{'error':'rejected'}])
# clone
check('clone copies contexts', evs(job(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},
      {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]},{'op':'inspect'}])),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[4294967295,1],[2,4294967295],[4294967295,4294967295]]}},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':2,'contexts':2,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])
check('clone inherits mark', evs(job(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':5},
      {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':5}])), None) if False else None
